description: Makes an earlier version (its number from site_status) the one the Development address serves, replacing the version it serves now; no version's files are deleted, so a later rollback can return to it. Answers PUBLISHED or FAILED, as site_publish does. The Live site changes only by site_promote. On the founder's Logs. This is what a founder may call going back to the old version, undoing or reverting.
name: site_rollback
title: Roll the Development site back
